newsitem.title: INDIA: India Century shr jumps on bonus news.
newsitem.headline: India Century shr jumps on bonus news.

text.p: The share of Century Textiles and Industries Ltd rose sharply on Monday after the company said it has convened a board meeting on May 6 to consider an issue of bonus equity shares, brokers said.
The share leapt 207.25 rupees, or 9.99 percent, to 2,282.25 at the Bombay Stock Exchange (BSE).
The flagship company of the B.K. Birla industrial group said the board will finalise accounts for the year ended March 31, 1997 and recommend a dividend at the same meeting.
The board will also consider a ten-for-one stock split, which envisages sub-dividing the 100-rupee face value stock into 10-rupee shares, the firm said in a note to the BSE.
On the National Stock Exchange, the share was up 102.60 rupees, or 4.9 percent, at 2,195.10.
